results.name: isElevenLabsConfigured() is true once a key is set
listVoiceProfiles returns all 8 real roster mentors
Only mentors with a real, already-configured voice ID are active (dominican/nicaragua/honduras/mexico/brazil)
A mentor with no real configured voice ID (cuba) is explicitly inactive, never fabricated as active
A mentor with a real configured voice and a working provider returns status "ready"
The ready response includes real audio, transcript, and a request ID
The transcript is the mentor's own real, server-owned approved text (not client-supplied)
A mentor with no real voice ID returns an honest "unavailable" status, never fabricated audio
An identical repeat request reuses the cached audio (no second provider call)
The cached result still returns status "ready" with the same real audio
Two concurrent identical requests (rapid double-click) result in exactly one real provider call
Both concurrent requests still resolve to a real ready result
A provider timeout returns an honest "provider_error" status, never fabricated audio
A provider 500 error returns an honest "provider_error" status, never fabricated audio
With no ElevenLabs API key configured, an active mentor still returns an honest "unavailable" status (never fabricated audio)
An out-of-range playback speed is clamped to a real allowed value, never stored as-is
